evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows'; changes CMake toolchain configuration, CI workflow files, and compiler support on Windows.
rationale: Migrating native Windows builds to clang-cl resolves recurring MSVC compiler bugs and internal errors (#31456, #36153) while reducing CI build time from 20m 35s to 12m 43s. It also brings significant runtime performance improvements and unblocks hardware-accelerated inline assembly on Windows.
